title: planars data dependency fact record list
description: A list of fact records documenting planars' data-dependency graph -- every case where the same fact is recorded in more than one place (a Drive Sheet, a local TSV, a schema YAML, a manifest, a GitHub issue, ...) and needs an explicit authority/cascade relationship written down. See SCHEMA.md for the full field-by-field specification and rationale.

detail.description: The specific file/field/attribute where this fact is recorded, in free text. When two locations share the same entity (e.g. a source construction_tsv and a dependent construction_tsv), use detail to disambiguate which one is meant by 'authoritative' below.

direction.description: automatic: a tool regenerates the non-authoritative copy. manual: a human must propagate the change by hand. bidirectional: edits can legitimately originate at either location, each with its own reconciliation path.

mechanism.description: The concrete script, function, or manual process that performs (or should perform) the cascade. Name the actual command/module, not just 'a script handles this.'

note.description: How drift can happen (or, if possible is false, why it can't).

caught_by.description: What actually catches drift if it happens: a specific integrity-check/check-codebook section, a GitHub issue label, a human review step, or an honest 'nothing yet'.

id.description: A short, stable, snake_case identifier for the fact.

description.description: A one-line, human-readable statement of what the fact is.

locations.description: Every place this fact is recorded. See SCHEMA.md's 'Known limitation' note: this schema cannot mechanically enforce that 'authoritative' below is one of these entities' values -- that is a documented limitation, checked by convention/review instead.
